setup.title: Set up the vault
setup.description: The vault encrypts the passwords and keys of your sites. Choose a master password you will remember: it cannot be reset without the recovery kit.

unlock.title: Unlock the vault
unlock.description: Enter your master password to use the saved credentials in this session.

kit.title: Save your recovery kit
kit.description: This is the only way back in if you forget the master password. It is shown once: store it somewhere safe and offline.

errors.invalid_secret: The master password is not right.
errors.vault_not_initialized: The vault is not set up yet.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
